description: Price new domains and mailboxes server-side. Creates a 15-minute quote; registers and charges nothing. Show human_summary to the user exactly before create_checkout. Ordering domains needs registrant with every one of: first_name, last_name, real_address, city, state_province, postal_code, country, phone, organization_name, job_title (email_address optional); collect them from the user upfront.

domains.description: New root domains to register (check them with check_domains first).

mailbox_domains.description: Instead of new domains: active domains the workspace already has (bought, or connected with connect_own_domains once list_domains shows dns_status active) to create the mailboxes on. Needs persona; no registrant.

mailboxes.description: Total mailbox slots to add (a new subscription starts at 12). With new domains, mailboxes are created and spread over them, at most 10 per domain; slots beyond that stay paid and are filled when a domain is added (the quote's human_summary says so).

mailboxes_per_domain.description: Alternative to mailboxes: this many on each new domain (or on each mailbox_domains entry).

redirect_domain.description: Where visitors of the new domains are redirected (usually the user's website).

registrant.description: Domain registrant contact, required when domains are ordered. Ask the user for ALL of these before calling quote_order, in one question; never invent them: first_name, last_name, real_address (street), city, state_province, postal_code, country, phone (international format, e.g. +15125550100), organization_name, job_title. email_address is optional (defaults to the account email).

test_mode.description: Stripe test mode, nothing registered or charged. Not available in production.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id. Optional: defaults to the workspace picked at sign-in or bound to the API key.

name: quote_order

next_step.description: What to do next, in one sentence.

title: Quote an order
